stock.description: China Graphite Group Limited, operating within the People's Republic of China, primarily focuses on the production and distribution of flake graphite concentrate and spherical graphite. The company obtains its vital raw materials through a dual approach: it extracts unprocessed graphite from its own Beishan Mine, an open-pit graphite ore operation located to the northwest of Luobei County in Heilongjiang Province, and also procures additional unprocessed graphite from external vendors. Additionally, the firm diversifies its offerings by selling unrefined marble. Its customer base predominantly includes industrial manufacturers and retailers who require materials for heat-resistant applications. Established in 2006, the company's main office is situated in Hegang, China. China Graphite Group Limited functions as a subsidiary under the ownership of Sandy Mining Limited.
